versions.changelog:
arch-review 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides structured architecture review based on OpenSpec documents and project code.
- Evaluates design at the module/component level across multiple dimensions defined by customizable templates.
- Generates actionable reports with scoring, strengths, weaknesses, and prioritized recommendations.
- Supports spec-only review (when code is missing), incremental reviews (using previous reports), and both sequential and parallel execution modes.
- Proactively suggests use during or before major implementation or refactoring phases in projects with OpenSpec specs.
